instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Salt extraction and refining facility producing 25,000 tons of industrial and food-grade salt annually from marine evaporation pans. Weather-dependent production cycles create significant forecasting challenges that impact logistics and operational scheduling. Evaluating brine concentration sensors and automated crystallization monitoring are key areas for efficiency improvement.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures, resulting in a documented 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. This initiative successfully validated predictive maintenance capabilities; however, the current bottleneck lies in integrating this data stream with our legacy operational software for actionable insights.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market saturation. We are actively exploring adjacent business models such as developing a localized salt quality data marketplace, implementing a simple subscription service for bulk clients, or building a proprietary data monetization play.
answers.additionalContext: Operational scaling is currently constrained by the founder's personal bandwidth and reliance on manual forecasting methods which limit proactive decision-making.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance Automation (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing IoT data to move beyond simple monitoring into automated alerts for equipment failure allows for optimized maintenance scheduling and further reduces unplanned downtime. This is a low-risk, high-impact incremental win that directly addresses current process inefficiencies.

first_actions: Develop a standardized dashboard view of sensor data insights
Pilot automated SMS/email alerts for critical brine pump monitoring thresholds
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned downtime by 5% within Q3

opportunities.title: Salt Quality Data Monetization Pilot (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Since we collect proprietary data on brine concentration and crystallization rates, packaging this anonymized or aggregated information into a basic subscription service for research or quality control firms represents a low-capital entry into an adjacent market. This aligns directly with the strategic goal of diversification.

first_actions: Define the minimum viable data package (e.g., quarterly concentration reports)
Identify 3 target niche buyers (e.g., agricultural researchers, food processing QC firms)
resources_needed: Contracting a freelance data analyst for 1 month ($2k est.)
Minimal marketing spend via industry networking
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 1 paying pilot customer by year-end
milestones: Q3: Data package finalized and validated.

next_steps.action: Formalize the predictive maintenance data pipeline and establish a small, defined process for data utilization.
Engage with potential niche markets to validate the concept of selling aggregated brine concentration data as a subscription service.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on owner decision-making, creating single points of failure and limiting innovation speed.
Fragmented operational data systems hindering scalable process optimization.
Low digital maturity preventing the effective utilization and analysis of existing sensor investments.
